qa/review.md (review): read the full diff 43f49fa..d3a7a9ad over offline-scorer, tsconfig.json, .github, charter/charter.toml and charter/owner-decisions, and all of offline-scorer/score.ts. Thirteen forgery inputs of my own beyond proof 4's six (repeated output key with hash of last value and of first value; label case/inner/outer whitespace; answers mixing two case sets; attempts 1,2,7; repeated floors key with old and with rebound answers; trailing-space subject id; BOM on the case set and on the answers file; attempt 1.0 and attempt "1"; an answer line carrying verdict/passed/score fields): each behaved as recorded in the review, nothing was scored that should have been refused. Hand-predicted my own three-subject set before running (exact floor, one below, exactly half of a case's attempts passing) and every predicted field matched. The scorer reads no recorded verdict and no field besides output can decide pass/fail; the oracle shares no code with the scorer and recomputes both sets; the four mutants are four different rules each failing only its own expectation; the scorer is unpublished (package.json files whitelist, categoryRoots, audit PASS (62 files)); collect.sh writes answers only from the harness log, and verify-evidence.sh alone could print evidence: ok for an answer whose output bytes differ from its log - QA-SZ-D1, closed transitively by the scorer in the same proof; the decision record's two quotations are exact (D3 truncated without an ellipsis - QA-SZ-D2) and claim no more authority than the packet and DECISIONS-1 carry; commit 380172b weakened no proof criterion and added one to proof 8; the contract states its scope honestly including what the real run does not prove. Evidence file sha256 0fee36eeac8bb6e5a94891f7733266c6765e23f1fe0f40712b4e61a7415c5c58.

new_defects.what_is_wrong: The script compares the sha256 of the log's final assistant text with the answer's recorded output_sha256 field and never reads answer.output, so run alone it can print evidence: ok while an answer's output bytes do not match its log (replace output and set output_sha256 to the log-text hash); the contract's proof 6 sentence says the script compares the log's text with the answer's output, which it does not do directly. The slice's proof still holds because the same proof runs the scorer, which forces output_sha256 = sha256(output), chaining the two checks.

The D3 quotation is cut off mid-sentence at 'stay outside the repository' with no ellipsis; the source item continues 'per mister-clean's INTENT; "private area" means code only.' The quoted words are exact and the dropped clause only adds sourcing context, so the citation is imprecise but does not inflate the claim.

Every reopen and mutant ran as bash --noprofile --norc -e -o pipefail -c from the root of QA/scratch with nice -n 10 timeout 900, TMPDIR=QA/tmp, and ~/.local/share/mise/installs/bun/1.4.0/bin first on PATH (bun 1.4.0); the pnpm, tsc, build:materials, audit:public and vitest commands of proof 8 ran from the checkout root as the contract's exception allows. No model was called, no server started, no cargo run. Only charter check --strict, gate slice-zero --verify and receipt on this receipt were available; only receipt was run. P was read, never written. Home paths written as ~; no personal data recorded; harness logs cited by path only.
